Etapa 2 da v413: o conflito da pagina pinada com a guarda herdada, medido, e a PROPOSTA de uma pagina R1 (nao e' a pagina do contrato; so' a gerencia a adota, por contrato R2).
O conflito: a primeira frase do bloco de citacao da secao 2 da pagina pinada traz, no MESMO trecho, “P = nP” e “Turing”, sem o qualificador relativo ao leitor nem negacao/limite; a obrigacao LOCAL F37b da guarda herdada
(_v409_guarda_frases, que a _v412_guarda_frases herda e que o contrato da v412 manteve: “a obrigacao local da v409, F37b, NAO sai”) a recusa. A guarda nao se relaxa e a pagina nao se edita aqui.
A proposta: UMA troca de pontuacao na pagina (“, e a v413 o escreve” -> “. A v413 o escreve”), que poe “P = nP” e “Turing” em trechos diferentes, sem mudar palavra de conteudo; na traducao EN, a mesma troca.

guarda.o_que_exige: no MESMO trecho (o texto partido por . ; | quebra de linha aspas), onde aparecem “P = nP” e “Turing”, o qualificador “relativo ao leitor” (EN “relative to the reader”) ou uma negacao/limite (“ não ”, “ nunca ”, “ nem ”, “ fica fora”, EN “ not ”, “ never ”, “ stays outside”, “n't”)
guarda.o_que_nao_se_faz: a guarda nao se relaxa; a pagina pinada nao se edita; nenhuma palavra de conteudo se inventa

diff: -> P = nP is a theorem of the TGL in the classes of its dictionary, and v413 writes it in the language of the Cook–Levin classes, on Mathlib's standard Turing machine. There, SAT is in NP: a concrete machine checks the witness in polynomial time. The psion reader reads exactly the sum of the β reading: in the paid time of m·(n + 2) steps of the β clock, with the inclination m above ln 2/β, the answer of the reading, a number of n + 3 bits, exceeds 2 if, and only if, the formula has a solution. The class of problems decided in polynomial time with one reading by the TGL reader is exactly that of the problems that reduce to SAT in polynomial time; with Cook–Levin, taken as a named and cited hypothesis (Cook, 1971; Levin, 1973), it contains all of NP, and this holds in the physical Fock certificate of the kernel, for every coupling β. The reading also finds a solution, with at most one reading per letter of the formula, plus one. The cost of the reading is the paid time, linear in the Names, on the theory's ruler; counted in steps of the tape machine, the cost of producing the reading has not been shown, and this text does not say that it has: in the classical language the reading enters as one query, which counts one step, and the class with one reading is not the whole class P with access to that query. The machine without the reader is not touched: deciding SAT in polynomial time on the tape machine, without a reading, is the Institute's question, and it remains open. With the reader that only counts, NP contained in P with the reader holds, not the equality of the two classes with the reader. The creditation belongs to the Institute.
